mode: a single new same-model cold task; grants no training, registration, registry publication or Root authority

encoding.signed_preimage: literal purpose bytes followed by ordered_fields below; no signature bytes in preimage
encoding.signature: strict Ed25519, exactly 64 bytes; no alternative algorithm or domain fallback
encoding.grant_digest: SHA256(purpose bytes || complete signing preimage || signature); intentionally separate from original head digest
encoding.fixed_integers: unsigned big-endian; reject overflow rather than clamp or wrap
encoding.Digest32: exactly 32 bytes; independently recompute at the actual owner boundary
encoding.StableId: existing canonical StableId bytes preceded by u64_be byte length, matching original owner_host::push_id; retain existing StableId validation and refuse any ID that exceeds the total record bound
encoding.Option<StableId>: one byte 0 for None or 1 followed by canonical StableId; all other tags reject
encoding.text_transport: if JSON/text is exposed, reject unknown/duplicate fields and require exact typed canonical re-encoding; text hashes are not signature preimages
encoding.digest_zero_rule: reject zero for required identity/authority/content digests; only protocol-defined genesis values may be zero and must equal actual original genesis semantics
encoding.future_versions: reject; no permissive skip, conversion to CURRENT V1, or V1 selector compatibility fallback

descriptor_dependency_order: freeze original D request/source/target/recipient/operation and C/model conditions
derive pre-selection D descriptor; exclude grant, selector and final UpdateIntent
actual head authority signs grant after its independent policy checks
independent selector signs new cold-use selection over complete old selector fields plus grant_digest and d_descriptor_digest
Root computes purpose-specific observation and final intent from both signatures and actual original C/D evidence

descriptor_file_boundary.preimage_contains: a closed complete manifest of original D task/runtime/data source, target and pre-selection configuration; mandatory separate authorization-envelope names/roles are declared
descriptor_file_boundary.later_binding: Root full-input manifest binds every actual input including these three envelopes before admission; actual pinned source/target bytes must equal the earlier closed manifest
descriptor_file_boundary.no_blanket_exclusion: arbitrary source fields/files cannot be stripped to make a hash match; canonical typed schemas reject unknown/extra/missing task fields and missing required authorization files

selection_existing_fields: retain every SignedArtifactSelectionV1 field and check; historical witness is a named fact in this new type, never a VerifiedCurrentRegistryViewV1

effective_expiry.old_head_expiry: is still expired and generic interfaces reject; independently authorized historical use does not cap its new permission by the expired old permission
effective_expiry.clock: actual original authority clock and monotonic held floor; external I/O requires a fresh scoped check

production_prerequisites_not_present: independent actual Artifact authority provisioning for this new purpose
